# Reference set: original ISO K22.exe under Wine 11.19/wined3d (reverse/wine-reference/set/, pass A of 2026-10-09).
# Native noise: the in-game captures of two consecutive native runs differ by <= 0.001 SSIM, so each in-game
# threshold is the measured native SSIM minus 0.03 (fails on a real native regression, not on run-to-run noise).
# Original-side noise (pass A vs a second pass B / an earlier run): level5 0.96-1.00, ev/tnel24 >= 0.998,
# cam1_loaded 0.97, start4_control 0.994, menu logos 1.0. Noisy on the original itself: kriz after load
# (atilgan_ai random() waypoints: A-B 0.97-0.99, A-earlier run 0.62-0.85), cam1_locked_door (A-B 0.73),
# movie frames (0.56-0.77). The native - original gap that remains is documented in docs/GAMEPLAY_TESTING.md.
# Masks/crops for animated content: HUD heart (0:0:120:120, beats); level5 ceiling fan (0:30:540:120, rotation phase);
# menus and the difficulty screen loop the kn_arg.k22 movie behind the panels, and its phase differs on both sides
# (native realtime runs too), so only the logo region is compared and the threshold sits above a black frame's SSIM
# (0.16-0.36) and below the lowest native run (0.47-0.58). Movie frames: above black (0.19-0.28), gross check only.
